oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: inference-runtime-high-latency detected for hosted/text-gen — triggered at 2026-03-12T22:00:00Z. P95 jumped from ~120ms to ~850ms. Pager: elena. Impact: several PLG customers reporting timeouts.

elena: on it. grabbing traces and tracing flags. paging runtime + infra. any immediate blockers? :pager:

samir: looking now — seeing KV cache miss rate spike + long tail in batch scheduling. popping the tail logs.

marta: saw ~30% of requests queued >250ms in the batcher. that corresponds with a change deployed 22:58 (quantization patch + batching tweak).

jamal: are we able to divert traffic to fallback model? suggest routing to smaller model to reduce pressure.

elena: yes — start mitigation steps. samir, can you isolate whether it's quantization or batching interplay?

samir: initial quick checks: KV hit rate dropped from 0.93 -> 0.54 around 22:59. Batcher queue length grew from median 2 -> 18. looks like combined effect.

samir: logs snippet:
```
[22:59:03] runtime: request 0x7f23 queued (batcher length=12, kv_hit=false)
[22:59:03] runtime: quantize_profile=recent-q8 -> exec_slowpath
[22:59:04] cache: get key user:prefix:abcd -> miss (origin=evict)
[22:59:04] scheduler: dispatch delayed (queue_wait=310ms)
```

elena: immediate plan: 1) temporarily disable the new quantization profile 2) flush KV cache selectively for hot prefixes 3) reduce batch window to lower queueing. I'll coordinate traffic routing.

deploy-bot: rolling config change request queued: disable-quant-recent (initiated by elena). CI checks pass.

elena: executing flush for hot prefixes for top 10 models. command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/kv/flush -d '{"prefixes": ["user:prefix:"]}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

marta: reducing batch window from 40ms -> 10ms now. patch deployed to batchers in us-west.

samir: quantization rollback started (reverting recent-q8). will watch kernel selection logs.

nora: routing 40% -> redwood-mini-beta (fallback) to relieve pressure.

elena: thanks, nora. placing short notice to support and customers: "We are routing a subset of traffic to a lower-latency variant; you may see slight quality differences."

jamal: monitoring metrics: after kv flush + batch window change + quant rollback, p95 dropped to ~180ms at 22:10 (10m after mitigation). KV hit rate recovering to 0.78.

samir: confirming CPU/GPU kernel fallback rate decreased. quantization regressions logged: increased decode GC in path, likely causing batcher contention.

elena: status update to channel: mitigations in place, system stable but still watching for 30m. will convene post-incident review tomorrow.

oncall-bot: incident status -> MONITORED. severity -> Sev2.

elena: assigning postmortem owners and follow-ups now. proposed meeting: 2026-03-13 10:00 PT (postmortem slot). Who can attend?

samir: I'll be there — will gather traces, kernel logs, and quantization diffs.

marta: I can cover batcher metrics and autoscaler signals.

jamal: I'll own customer impact summary + support thread excerpts.

nora: I'll extract routing changes and rollback timeline from control plane.

elena: agreed. action items (short):
- ACTION-1: deep root cause analysis for KV miss spike (owner: samir, due: 2026-03-18)
- ACTION-2: add preflight checks to quantization deploys to detect throughput regressions (owner: marta, due: 2026-03-20)
- ACTION-3: batching safety net: auto-reduce batch window when queueing > X ms (owner: jamal, due: 2026-03-22)
- ACTION-4: add KV cache warmup job and alert on hit-rate drop > 15% (owner: nora, due: 2026-03-19)
- ACTION-5: customer comms follow-up and SLA impact assessment (owner: jamal, due: 2026-03-16)

samir: for ACTION-1, initial hypothesis: an eviction cascade from a transient GC combined with a quantization code path that increases per-request kernel latency, causing backpressure on the batcher which then increases cold-cache misses. will validate with flame graphs and kernel timing.

marta: for ACTION-2, propose adding a perf-benchmark gate that runs a short tail-latency workload on canaries (5k reqs) before promoting quant changes.

elena: assigning owners in calendar invite now. please add evidence to the postmortem doc in /docs/incidents/ (I'll create the doc).

deploy-bot: config revert complete: disable-quant-recent -> OK (completed at 2026-03-12T22:12:34Z).

elena: verifying final numbers: p95 steady ~135ms, error rate normal, KV hit rate ~0.88. closing immediate incident.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by elena at 2026-03-12T23:00:40Z. follow-up: postmortem scheduled.

jamal: I'll draft the initial postmortem and circulate before the meeting. tagging @customers-support for any outstanding tickets.

nora: created a tracking board card: "Runtime: KV+Batching+Quant regression" with the ACTION items linked.

elena: final note: strong signal to treat quantization changes as both correctness and perf-risk. we need better instrumentation (per-kernel latency) and staged rollouts. thanks all for quick response. :heart:

samir: adding kernel-level histograms to the runtime telemetry plan. linking to the task in the postmortem doc.

marta: will prototype an emergency throttle in the batcher that drops batching window if queue latency > 200ms.

elena: handing off to night oncall (nora) at 2026-03-12T23:05Z — I'm available if anything noisy happens.

nora: ack, monitoring.

(elapsed time: ~1h)
